chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated to me from 'Ali ibn Muhammad ibn 'Ali, who raised it (to the Imam), saying:
He said: In order to seal the clay of the grave of Husain (peace be upon him), one should recite 'Inna Anzalnahu' (Surah Al-Qadr) on it.

key_terms.إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ: Indeed, We sent it down (Surah Al-Qadr)
key_terms.طِينِ قَبْرِ الْحُسَيْنِ: Clay of the grave of Husain

ai.seo_question: What should be recited on the clay of Imam Husain's grave before sealing it?
ai.summary: This hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* establishes a specific ritual for sealing the clay (turab) of Imam Husain (a.s.) by reciting Surah Al-Qadr, linking the sanctity of the grave to the Night of Decree. This practice underscores the Shia belief in the spiritual potency of the Imams' remains, connecting the martyrdom of Husain with the divine revelation of the Quran. The recitation serves to consecrate the clay, transforming it into a medium for blessings (barakah) and intercession.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 7. Muḥammad ibn Ya’qūb narrated to me from ‘Ali ibn Muḥammad, who narrated that:
He said: In order to seal the clay of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) one should recite (the chapter of) Innā Anzalnāh on it.
